SLA CREDIT MEMORANDUM — Master Services Agreement with Jaffle Equipment (CLI-0042), contract CON-0042-01. Effective 2025-02-05.~~NL~~Pursuant to the credit clause of the MSA, Jaffle Logistics acknowledges that the January 14-16 winter storm at the Chicago hub caused on-time performance to fall below the contracted target. Root event documented under incident INC-2025-00417. Jaffle Logistics will apply a credit of 1.0% of January spend per full percentage point below target, capped at 10%. This memorandum does not otherwise modify the MSA.

INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR DRIVER AGREEMENT — DRV-01188. Effective 2022-06-13.~~NL~~1. RELATIONSHIP. Contractor operates as an independent contractor, not an employee.~~NL~~2. PERFORMANCE. Contractor shall complete assigned routes within service windows and promptly notify dispatch of any inability to perform.~~NL~~3. TERMINATION FOR CAUSE. Jaffle Logistics may deactivate the contractor for repeated failure to perform or failure to notify, including no-call/no-show events.~~NL~~4. DISPUTE. Disputes shall first be raised with People Ops and Legal before external remedies.
